  have h₁ : IsLeast {y : ℝ | ∃ r s t : ℝ, True ∧ putnam_1981_b2_solution = y} putnam_1981_b2_solution := by

  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)
  unfold putnam_1981_b2_solution at heq
